hooks.command: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd) && if [ -f sdk-py/pyproject.toml ]; then cd sdk-py && uv run mypy --no-error-summary --no-pretty 2>&1 | head -20 || true; fi
echo '=== Files staged for commit ===' && git diff --cached --name-only | head -20 && echo '===' && echo 'Verify only relevant files are staged'
